Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 16

“What is action and what is inaction? Even the wise are confused about this. I shall explain action to you, knowing which you will be freed from evil.”

A rare admission that even sages stumble here, offered just before the chapter's most demanding passage. Krishna is preparing Arjuna to find what follows difficult.
